title: mesa-ibi-scanner
description:
Research prototype that evaluates MESA Invariant 1 (directed inbound trifecta closure Cl(b)) over a typed agent/service interaction graph, with PDP cut semantics, topology JSON ingestion, and CI-friendly text/JSON/SARIF output.

Not for production policy enforcement. Companion ACM and topology JSON Schemas included. Companion paper: 10.5281/zenodo.22761743 (concept 10.5281/zenodo.22743175).
